description: List the INSTANT LEAD FORMS on a connected Facebook Page — id, name, status, how many leads each has collected and what each one asks. This is where the formId every other lead tool needs comes from, and calling it before create_meta_lead_form is how you avoid building a duplicate. Read-only, free. NEEDS the pages_manage_ads permission, which Hermoso’s Meta consent screen asks for. If Meta answers "Requires pages_manage_ads", the user must RECONNECT Meta under Connectors > Meta — a connection made before that permission was added cannot gain it by retrying. Call the tool rather than pre-refusing: any refusal comes from Meta and names the one thing that fixes it.

pageId.description: Which connected Page — required only if the profile has more than one

name: list_meta_lead_forms
title: List Meta instant (lead) forms
